question: ______ was an Indian dancer and choreographer best known for creating a fusion style of dance adapting European theatrical techniques to Indian classical and folkdance forms.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uday Shankar**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Uday Shankar** was an Indian dancer and choreographer best known for creating a fusion style of dance adapting European theatrical techniques to Indian classical and folk dance forms.
 
• He is often referred to as the father of modern dance in India.
 
• Uday Shankar's innovative approach helped popularize Indian dance on the global stage.
 
• He received numerous awards and accolades for his contributions to the arts, including the Sangeet Natak Akademi Fellowship.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Uday Shankar was born on December 8, 1900, in Udaipur, Rajasthan, India.
 
• He was the elder brother of the famous sitar virtuoso Ravi Shankar.
 
• In 1930, Uday Shankar formed his own dance company and toured extensively, showcasing his unique dance style to audiences worldwide.
 
• He established the Uday Shankar India Culture Centre in Almora in 1938, which became a hub for training and nurturing young talents in dance and music.
 
• Uday Shankar's legacy continues to inspire generations of dancers and choreographers in India and abroad.
